BiblicalUsage: Tabrimmon was a Syrian, the father of Ben-hadad, king of Syria, and the grandfather of the Ben-hadad Asa bribed with temple silver. The Chronicler's spelling of his name is Tabrimon. He is named once, as a link in a chain of Syrian kings who troubled Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the one-verse kings matter because they show how the nations pressed on Israel generation after generation, and how Asa's silver bought only a short peace.
